name: Incremental Pipeline
description: Delta processing pipeline - enriches model from various sources

stages.name: Fetch Delta
stages.description: Fetch only changed data since last sync

agentTier.rationale: Delta fetch is a straightforward operation using timestamps or hashes

processHints: Verify last sync timestamp is valid before fetching

stages.name: Diff
stages.description: Compare delta with existing model to identify changes

agentTier.rationale: Diffing requires comparing structured data but follows defined rules

chunkGuidance.splitStrategy: Group changes by node type for coherent diffs

processHints: Distinguish between structural changes and attribute-only changes
Flag deletions for human review before applying

stages.name: Transform Changes
stages.description: Transform change set to graph operations

agentTier.rationale: Transforming changes to graph operations requires understanding model semantics

chunkGuidance.splitStrategy: Process additions first, then modifications, then deletions

processHints: Order operations: additions before modifications before deletions
Validate that modifications don't break existing edges
Deletions should cascade to dependent edges

stages.name: Merge

agentTier.rationale: Merge must handle conflicts, ordering, and rollback decisions

chunkGuidance.splitStrategy: Apply operations in dependency order; batch by operation type

processHints: Always snapshot before merge (preActions enforces this)
Apply additions before modifications before deletions
On conflict, prefer the newer data but flag for review

stages.name: Verify

agentTier.rationale: Verification after incremental changes requires understanding what changed and why

processHints: Focus verification on changed nodes and their neighbors
Check that deletions haven't created orphan nodes
Verify edge consistency for modified nodes

stages.name: Report

agentTier.rationale: Report generation aggregates stage results; moderate complexity

processHints: Highlight any merge conflicts that were auto-resolved
